measures.title: Lorain County – Proposed Tax Levy (Additional), Children Services and Bureau of Children with Medical Handicaps
measures.summary: Asks Lorain County voters to approve a new 0.45-mill property tax for 5 years, beginning in 2026 and first due in 2027. The money supports Children Services, including the care and placement of abused, neglected and dependent children, and the Bureau of Children with Medical Handicaps. The county auditor estimates it will collect $5,405,086 a year, or $16 for each $100,000 of the auditor's market value.
measures.yesMeans: The county levies an additional 0.45-mill tax for 5 years for Children Services and the Bureau of Children with Medical Handicaps.
measures.noMeans: The additional 0.45-mill tax is not levied.

measures.title: Lorain County – Proposed Tax Levy (Renewal), Lorain County General Health District
measures.summary: Asks voters to renew a property tax of up to 0.5 mill for 5 years, beginning in 2027 and first due in 2028, for the operating expenses of the Lorain County General Health District. The county auditor estimates it will collect $3,785,431 a year, or $11 for each $100,000 of the auditor's market value. It is on the ballot everywhere in Lorain County except the City of Vermilion.
measures.yesMeans: The existing 0.5-mill health district levy is renewed for 5 years.
measures.noMeans: The health district levy is not renewed.
